attempts.sql: WITH kind_list(kind) AS (VALUES ('class'), ('function'), ('method')), counts AS (SELECT p.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS p INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON p.file_id = f.file_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method') AND f.is_test = FALSE AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND p.qualname NOT LIKE '%<locals>%' AND (p.kind = 'method' OR p.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT k.kind AS kind, CAST(COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS INTEGER) AS public_count FROM kind_list AS k LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON k.kind = c.kind ORDER BY k.kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This counts public symbols in the kumo package broken out by kind. It uses the symbol profile's public flag and symbol kind, joined to the files table to restrict scope to files under the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ path and to exclude test files, while dropping nested functions (qualified names containing a dot or '<locals>') and nested classes (qualified names containing a dot). A fixed list of the three kinds is left-joined to the counts so classes, functions and methods each appear once, defaulting to zero when none qualify, and the rows are ordered by kind.
sql: WITH kind_list(kind) AS (VALUES ('class'), ('function'), ('method')), counts AS (SELECT p.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS p INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON p.file_id = f.file_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method') AND f.is_test = FALSE AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND p.qualname NOT LIKE '%<locals>%' AND (p.kind = 'method' OR p.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT k.kind AS kind, CAST(COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS INTEGER) AS public_count FROM kind_list AS k LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON k.kind = c.kind ORDER BY k.kind
